answers.text: "Not near the high: 7.5% under the 20-day high." The 7.5% is the base's depth under its pivot, not a failed trend; it is why I buy only the clear of pivot_high (C5), not now. H1 LH/LL is a frame my base read does not use. Not conceded.

"A pullback, not a new high; one name is no group." My claim was stack, RS and sector, and W swing HH/HL with close_vs_swing_high_pct 19.48 still says stage 2 (C3). I agree D close_vs_swing_high_pct -6.93 is a reaction inside the base, so no buy until pivot_high clears on volume (C5) - that is already my trigger. Sector state is context for C15, not a group count. Not conceded.
